Watch Bollywood Hit Classic Song 'Bachpan Ke Din Bhoolana Dena' from blockbuster black & white family drama romantic movie Deedar (1951) directed by Nitin Bose. The movie stars Dilip Kumar, Ashok Kumar, Nargis, Nimmi. Music composed by Naushad. This song was sung by Shamshad Begum & Lata Mangeshkar.
Movie: Deedar (1951)
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar, Shamshad Begum
Music: Naushad
Lyrics: Shakeel Badayuni
Cast: Dilip Kumar, Nargis
Director: Nitin Bose
